TestLargeColumnsWithCDC::test_single_col.description: Single node (--smp=2 --memory=2048M), table with one blob column and CDC preimage full + postimage. Inserts 12 rows of 7MB, then for 60s concurrently updates them with 4MB blobs, reads base rows and reads cdc log (LIMIT 10). Asserts no 'Reactor stall' (prepared only) and no unexpected log errors (bad_alloc / memory_limit_reached ignored). Guards CDC linearization of large values (scylladb#7506) and LSA OOM (scylladb#27539).

Downgraded: assertions weak. Bug: execute_query (test_cdc_large_values.py:234-243) and execute_query_during_timeout (:246-270) swallow all exceptions (raise_exception=False), so every write/read may fail and the test still passes; no data or CDC-log content is validated. Note: `assert not found` after self.check_errors (:231-232) is a no-op (check_errors asserts internally and returns None, dtest_setup.py:594). Note: compaction_large_{row,cell}_warning_threshold_mb set to 20*MB (:31) = 20971520 MB, unit mix-up (effectively disables warnings). Unused import issue_open (:14). Note: flaky history (scylladb#27539) fixed only by doubling memory.

TestLargeColumnsWithCDC::test_row_with_s.description: Single node, table with 5 blob columns and CDC preimage full + postimage. Inserts 12 rows of 5x1MB, then for 60s concurrently updates all 5 columns, reads base rows and cdc log. Asserts no 'Reactor stall' and no 'oversized allocation' (both prepared only) and no unexpected log errors. Guards CDC handling of large rows split across columns (scylladb#7506).

TestLargeColumnsWithCDC::test_large_blob.description: Single node, table with map<text,blob> and CDC preimage full + postimage. Inserts 12 rows with one 1MB map entry, then for 60s appends 1MB entries (v = v + {keyK}, 5 keys) while reading base rows and cdc log. Asserts no 'Reactor stall' (prepared only) and no unexpected log errors. Guards CDC delta/preimage on large collections (scylladb#7506, oversized allocations scylladb#11642).
